data.one_liner: A package to help you build highly customisable timelines with Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides the TimelineTile widget to build vertical or horizontal timelines with custom indicators, icons, lines, and child widgets. Supports multiple alignment options and dividers to connect differently aligned tiles.
use_when: You need to display chronological events or step-by-step processes in your UI.
You want customizable timeline indicators, icons, and connecting lines.
You need both vertical and horizontal timeline layouts.
avoid_when: You are building generic lists or grids that do not require timeline connectors or indicators.
You need complex graph visualizations or charts.
strengths: Supports both vertical and horizontal axes.
Highly customizable indicators, icons, and lines.
Multiple alignment options including start, end, center, and manual.
weaknesses: Requires manual constraint handling (such as minHeight or minWidth) when providing children.
